patch_description: Replaces fully uniform parameter sharing with a bipartite scheme based on the 3D hypercube's parity (even vs odd Hamming weight). This doubles the expressivity while rigorously preserving the structural symmetry of the ansatz, preventing overfitting. Additionally, single-qubit rotation layers are interleaved with the specific dimensional layers of CZ entangling gates to generate structured, full-register entanglement more efficiently.
